executiveSummary: Sep 8 starts from a likely digestion/rotation setup after Sep 7's narrow Nikkei +2.12% rally. U.S. cash market is closed for Labor Day, so there is no fresh U.S. cash-session confirmation overnight. Domestic macro releases at 08:30/08:50, after-hours disclosures, PTS, yen strength, oil and SQ-week derivatives matter more than usual. A 23:51 user-provided Buffett Code PTS snapshot strengthens the case for fresh-catalyst and defense-drone names: Howa Machinery, Hagihara Industries, Quantum Solutions, Northsand and Foreside show materially positive PTS reactions, while several prior-day AI mega-cap leaders are softer. PTS ranking alone is not a buy signal; turnover and catalyst quality materially change the ranking.

rankingImpact: Upgrade Howa Machinery to top-tier tactical watch because +3.3% PTS came with roughly 2.5bn yen estimated turnover after a limit-up cash session.
Keep Hagihara Industries high: +3.4% with roughly 107m yen estimated turnover validates the earnings/DBJ catalyst better than a thin PTS print would.
Quantum Solutions is a high-volatility event name, not a core swing candidate, despite +10.8% and >100m yen PTS turnover; financing/execution needs verification.
Northsand moves into the fresh-catalyst watch due to Prime application plus +7.5% PTS, with Sep 11 earnings as event risk.
Foreside remains speculative because the acquisition catalyst is real but earnings contribution is not quantified.
Fit Easy, Triple Eyes and Appier PTS percentage moves are not strong enough in turnover terms to justify promotion.
Morfo/Terra Drone together suggest Physical AI sentiment is still active, but Morfo's Sep 7 intraday failure and Sep 11 earnings demand caution.

structuralThemeWatch.note: Sep 7 cash leaders were strong but night PTS in prior observations showed some cooling; do not assume another gap-and-go.
Sep 7 confirmed money spreading from Kioxia into equipment/material suppliers; deeper value-chain review needed.
Howa's roughly 2.5bn yen estimated PTS turnover materially strengthens the theme's tactical relevance for Sep 8.
Morfo and Terra Drone PTS are positive, but Morfo had a severe intraday reversal and DMP faces margin restrictions.
Sep 7 showed headline importance does not automatically translate into INPEX relative strength.
Sep 8 08:30/08:50 data can reprice this theme immediately before the open.
